name: aakash-business-erp
description: Aakash Business ERP - one package to install, build and run the whole ERP (API + React app) on a cloud host such as Yeti Cloud. See docs/DEPLOY_YETI_CLOUD.md.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build: cd client && GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false npm run build
